newsitem.title: USA: Live Entertainment contacted about sale.
newsitem.headline: Live Entertainment contacted about sale.

text.p: LIVE Entertainment Inc Friday said it continues to pursue the equity recapitalization efforts that were previously announced and is negotiating terms for an exchange offer.
In addition, the company said it has been approached by an unnamed suitor about a possible transaction involving the sale of the entire company.

In a statement, the company said any transactions would be subject to a number of conditions, and there are no assurances that either of these transactions, or any other alternative transactions, will be finalized or completed.
LIVE Entertainment specializes in the domestic and international marketing and distribution of filmed entertainment with its primary focus on motion pictures.
